description: OAuth callback decision machine conformance vectors. Canonical: betterbase-auth::oauth_callback::CallbackMachine. Format per case: `start` is the OAuthCallbackSpec, `actions` the full action trace (last = terminal done with outcome), `events` the host events fed between actions, `finalState` the terminal machine state. Credential-free by construction.
